news.headline: Global bond rout lifts US Treasury yields to multi‑decade highs
news.body: A worldwide sell‑off in government bonds pushed U.S. Treasury yields to their highest levels in about 24 years, weighing on stock markets and strengthening the dollar. Investors are now focused on upcoming U.S. jobs and euro‑zone inflation data for clues on central bank policy adjustments.
